text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe was unable to win the 
Japanese Derby. However――

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She managed to connect on a heart-to-heart 
level with Zenno Rob Roy, who claimed 
first place. Their next goal was the 
Kikuka Sho—or so it was supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Neo Universe said she wanted to 
create connections with more rivals, and 
to resonate with the older generation as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And— there was an Umamusume she 
specifically wished to "communicate" with. 
And the only place that could come true 
was the Takarazuka Kinen.
